findings.detail: basis_spread values 650 and 775 are source basis-point spreads stored as whole-number percentages; they should be normalized to 6.50 and 7.75.
basis_spread values 1000, 1075, and 1225 reflect all-in Interest Rate cells scaled by 100 rather than the source Interest Term spread.

rationale: The raw SOI separates Interest Term from Interest Rate. The flagged basis_spread values are not valid whole-number percentage spreads: 1075, 1000, and 1225 match all-in Interest Rate cells such as 10.75%, 10.00%, and 12.25% scaled by 100, while the corresponding source spread terms are lower values such as S + 550, S + 525, and S + 675. Other flagged values such as 650 and 775 are source basis-point notation that require percentage normalization to 6.50 and 7.75 under the platform convention.
